# Subset Construction (NFA → DFA)

This notebook walks through the **subset construction** algorithm that converts
any NFA into an equivalent DFA.  The running example is the NFA that accepts
exactly the words over $\{a,b\}$ that end in the letter $a$.

**NFA states:**

- $q_s$ — *scanning* (initial, non-accepting)
- $q_a$ — *accept* (accepting)

**NFA transitions:**
$\Delta(q_s,a)=\{q_s,q_a\}$,  $\Delta(q_s,b)=\{q_s\}$,  $\Delta(q_a,\cdot)=\varnothing$.

---

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var STEPS = [
    { explain: "<b>Step 0 &mdash; Initialise.</b> The initial DFA state is the set of NFA start states: <code>{q&#x209B;}</code>. Add it to the <em>worklist</em>.", worklist:["{qs}"], processed:[], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 1 &mdash; Pop {q&#x209B;}.</b> Dequeue the first element and start computing its outgoing transitions.", worklist:[], processed:[], hn:["qs"], dn:[], he:[], rows:[], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 2 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x209B;, a).</b> From q&#x209B; reading <code>a</code> we follow the self-loop (q&#x209B;&rarr;q&#x209B;) <em>and</em> the arc to q&#x2090;. Result: <code>{q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;}</code>.", worklist:[], processed:[], hn:["qs","qa"], dn:[], he:["loop","qa"], rows:[], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 3 &mdash; {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;} is new!</b> This macro-state has never been seen, so add it to the worklist.", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:[], hn:["qa"], dn:[], he:[], rows:[], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 4 &mdash; Record &delta;({q&#x209B;}, a) = {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;}.</b> Enter this transition into the DFA table (highlighted in gold).", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:[], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:"{qs}|a" },
    { explain: "<b>Step 5 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x209B;, b).</b> From q&#x209B; reading <code>b</code> only the self-loop fires. Result: <code>{q&#x209B;}</code>.", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:[], hn:["qs"], dn:[], he:["loop"], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 6 &mdash; {q&#x209B;} already known.</b> The result is already in our state set &mdash; no new state is added.", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:[], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 7 &mdash; Record &delta;({q&#x209B;}, b) = {q&#x209B;}.</b> Self-loop on DFA state {q&#x209B;} under <code>b</code>.", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:[], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:"{qs}|b" },
    { explain: "<b>Step 8 &mdash; {q&#x209B;} fully processed.</b> Both symbols handled. {q&#x209B;} moves to <em>processed</em>.", worklist:["{qs,qa}"], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 9 &mdash; Pop {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;}.</b> Dequeue the next element and begin processing its transitions.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:["qs","qa"], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 10 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x209B;, a) for symbol a.</b> The q&#x209B; component contributes {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;} (self-loop + arc highlighted).", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:["qs","qa"], dn:[], he:["loop","qa"], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 11 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x2090;, a) = &empty;.</b> q&#x2090; has <em>no</em> outgoing transitions &mdash; it is a dead end (shown in red). Contribution: &empty;.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:["qa"], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 12 &mdash; Union: {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;} &cup; &empty; = {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;}.</b> Already a known DFA state &mdash; nothing added to the worklist.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 13 &mdash; Record &delta;({q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;}, a) = {q&#x209B;, q&#x2090;}.</b> Self-loop on DFA state {q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;} under <code>a</code>.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:"{qs,qa}|a" },
    { explain: "<b>Step 14 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x209B;, b).</b> The q&#x209B; component under <code>b</code> gives {q&#x209B;} via the self-loop.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:["qs"], dn:[], he:["loop"], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 15 &mdash; Compute &Delta;(q&#x2090;, b) = &empty;.</b> q&#x2090; contributes nothing under <code>b</code> either (dead end, shown in red).", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:["qa"], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 16 &mdash; Union: {q&#x209B;} &cup; &empty; = {q&#x209B;}.</b> Already known &mdash; no addition to the worklist.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:null}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 17 &mdash; Record &delta;({q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;}, b) = {q&#x209B;}.</b> Transition from {q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;} under <code>b</code> recorded.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:"{qs,qa}|b" },
    { explain: "<b>Step 18 &mdash; {q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;} fully processed. Worklist is empty &mdash; the algorithm terminates.</b>", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}","{qs,qa}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}"}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 19 &mdash; Identify accepting DFA states.</b> A DFA state S is accepting iff S &cap; F &ne; &empty;, where F = {q&#x2090;}.<br>&bull; {q&#x209B;} &cap; {q&#x2090;} = &empty; &rarr; <em>non-accepting</em><br>&bull; {q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;} &cap; {q&#x2090;} &ne; &empty; &rarr; <b>ACCEPTING &#x2605;</b>", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}","{qs,qa}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}",final:false},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}",final:true}], hc:null },
    { explain: "<b>Step 20 &mdash; Construction complete! &#x2713;</b> The DFA has exactly 2 reachable states. Initial: {q&#x209B;} (non-accepting). Accepting: {q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;} &#x2605;.", worklist:[], processed:["{qs}","{qs,qa}"], hn:[], dn:[], he:[], rows:[{from:"{qs}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}",final:false},{from:"{qs,qa}",a:"{qs,qa}",b:"{qs}",final:true}], hc:null }
  ];

  var idx = 0;
  var stepBtn   = document.getElementById("w1-step");
  var resetBtn  = document.getElementById("w1-reset");
  var progressEl= document.getElementById("w1-progress");
  var explainEl = document.getElementById("w1-explain");
  var worklistEl= document.getElementById("w1-worklist");
  var procEl    = document.getElementById("w1-processed");
  var tableBody = document.getElementById("w1-table-body");

  function badges(el, items, cls) {
    el.innerHTML = "";
    if (!items.length) {
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "sc-badge-empty"; s.textContent = "\u2205";
      el.appendChild(s);
    } else {
      items.forEach(function(it) {
        var b = document.createElement("span");
        b.className = "sc-badge " + cls; b.textContent = it;
        el.appendChild(b);
      });
    }
  }

  function renderTable(rows, hc) {
    tableBody.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (row.final === true) tr.className = "final-row";
      var label = row.final === true ? "\u2605 " + row.from : row.from;
      var tdS = document.createElement("td"); tdS.textContent = label;
      var tdA = document.createElement("td"); tdA.textContent = row.a || "\u2014";
      if (hc === row.from + "|a") tdA.className = "highlight";
      var tdB = document.createElement("td"); tdB.textContent = row.b || "\u2014";
      if (hc === row.from + "|b") tdB.className = "highlight";
      tr.append(tdS, tdA, tdB);
      tableBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function applyNfa(s) {
    var qs = document.getElementById("nfa-node-qs");
    var qa = document.getElementById("nfa-node-qa");
    qs.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (s.hn.includes("qs") ? " active" : "") + (s.dn.includes("qs") ? " dead" : "");
    qa.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (s.hn.includes("qa") ? " active" : "") + (s.dn.includes("qa") ? " dead" : "");
    var loop = document.getElementById("w1-edge-loop");
    var arc  = document.getElementById("w1-edge-qa");
    loop.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-edge" + (s.he.includes("loop") ? " active" : "");
    arc.className.baseVal  = "sc-nfa-edge" + (s.he.includes("qa")   ? " active" : "");
    loop.setAttribute("marker-end", s.he.includes("loop") ? "url(#w1-arrow-red)" : "url(#w1-arrow)");
    arc.setAttribute ("marker-end", s.he.includes("qa")   ? "url(#w1-arrow-red)" : "url(#w1-arrow)");
  }

  function render() {
    var s = STEPS[idx];
    progressEl.textContent = "Step " + idx + " / " + (STEPS.length - 1);
    explainEl.innerHTML    = s.explain;
    badges(worklistEl, s.worklist, "worklist");
    badges(procEl,     s.processed, "processed");
    renderTable(s.rows, s.hc);
    applyNfa(s);
    stepBtn.disabled  = idx >= STEPS.length - 1;
    resetBtn.disabled = idx === 0;
  }

  stepBtn.addEventListener("click",  function() { if (idx < STEPS.length - 1) { idx++; render(); } });
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { idx = 0; render(); });
  render();
})();
</script>
```

## Widget 2: Word Simulation

Type a word over $\{a,b\}$ (default `aba`) and step through it.
Each step reads one symbol and shows both the NFA active-state set and the
current DFA state — demonstrating the **invariant**: *DFA state = set of active NFA states*.

```{=html}
<div class="sc-lab" id="w2-lab">
  <div class="sc-field">
    <label for="w2-input">Input word over {a,b}</label>
    <input id="w2-input" value="aba" spellcheck="false" inputmode="text">
  </div>
  <div class="sc-btn-row">
    <button class="sc-btn" id="w2-step">Step &#x2192;</button>
    <button class="sc-btn alt" id="w2-reset">Reset</button>
    <span class="sc-progress" id="w2-progress"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="sc-explain" id="w2-explain"></div>
  <div class="sc-symbol-track" id="w2-track"></div>

  <div class="sc-two-graphs">
    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>NFA &mdash; active states</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 530 200" role="img" aria-label="NFA active states">
        <defs>
          <marker id="w2-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
          <marker id="w2-arrow-red" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#fc5130"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <line x1="52" y1="100" x2="112" y2="100" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#w2-arrow)"/>
        <path id="w2-nfa-loop" class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 126 76 C 90 15, 192 15, 155 76" marker-end="url(#w2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="132" y="22">a, b</text>
        <path id="w2-nfa-arc" class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 168 100 L 372 100" marker-end="url(#w2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="263" y="93">a</text>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="w2-nfa-qs" transform="translate(140,100)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x209B;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="w2-nfa-qa" transform="translate(400,100)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x2090;</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>

    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>DFA &mdash; current state</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 530 230" role="img" aria-label="DFA current state">
        <defs>
          <marker id="w2-dfa-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
          <marker id="w2-dfa-arrow-red" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#fc5130"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <line x1="42" y1="120" x2="88" y2="120" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#w2-dfa-arrow)"/>
        <path id="dfa-s0b" class="sc-dfa-edge" d="M 114 95 C 80 40, 182 40, 148 95" marker-end="url(#w2-dfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-dfa-edge-label" x="118" y="42">b</text>
        <path id="dfa-s0a" class="sc-dfa-edge" d="M 164 120 L 358 120" marker-end="url(#w2-dfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-dfa-edge-label" x="252" y="112">a</text>
        <path id="dfa-s1a" class="sc-dfa-edge" d="M 374 95 C 340 40, 442 40, 408 95" marker-end="url(#w2-dfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-dfa-edge-label" x="385" y="42">a</text>
        <path id="dfa-s1b" class="sc-dfa-edge" d="M 366 138 C 320 185, 210 185, 162 138" marker-end="url(#w2-dfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-dfa-edge-label" x="252" y="185">b</text>
        <g class="sc-dfa-node" id="dfa-node-s0" transform="translate(130,120)">
          <circle r="34"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="-4" font-size="11">S&#x2080;</text>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="11" font-size="10">{q&#x209B;}</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-dfa-node" id="dfa-node-s1" transform="translate(400,120)">
          <circle r="40" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="34"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="-4" font-size="11">S&#x2081; &#x2605;</text>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="11" font-size="10">{q&#x209B;,q&#x2090;}</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel" style="margin-top:0;">
    <h4>Simulation trace</h4>
    <table class="sc-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Prefix</th><th>NFA active states</th><th>DFA state</th><th>Accepted?</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="w2-trace"></tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="margin-top:10px;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--sc-label);" id="w2-invariant"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  function nfaStep(states, sym) {
    var next = {};
    states.forEach(function(s) {
      if (s === "qs") {
        next["qs"] = true;
        if (sym === "a") next["qa"] = true;
      }
    });
    return Object.keys(next).sort();
  }

  function dfaOf(nfaStates) { return nfaStates.indexOf("qa") >= 0 ? "s1" : "s0"; }

  function fmtNfa(states) {
    if (!states.length) return "\u2205";
    return "{" + states.map(function(s){ return s === "qs" ? "q\u209B" : "q\u2090"; }).join(", ") + "}";
  }

  function sanitize(v) { return v.toLowerCase().replace(/[^ab]/g, ""); }

  var inputEl   = document.getElementById("w2-input");
  var stepBtn   = document.getElementById("w2-step");
  var resetBtn  = document.getElementById("w2-reset");
  var progressEl= document.getElementById("w2-progress");
  var explainEl = document.getElementById("w2-explain");
  var trackEl   = document.getElementById("w2-track");
  var traceEl   = document.getElementById("w2-trace");
  var invEl     = document.getElementById("w2-invariant");

  var w2NfaQs   = document.getElementById("w2-nfa-qs");
  var w2NfaQa   = document.getElementById("w2-nfa-qa");
  var w2NfaLoop = document.getElementById("w2-nfa-loop");
  var w2NfaArc  = document.getElementById("w2-nfa-arc");
  var dfaS0     = document.getElementById("dfa-node-s0");
  var dfaS1     = document.getElementById("dfa-node-s1");
  var edgeS0b   = document.getElementById("dfa-s0b");
  var edgeS0a   = document.getElementById("dfa-s0a");
  var edgeS1a   = document.getElementById("dfa-s1a");
  var edgeS1b   = document.getElementById("dfa-s1b");

  var symIdx, nfaActive, dfaCur, rows;

  function renderTrack(word) {
    trackEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (!word.length) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym"; sp.textContent = "\u03b5";
      trackEl.appendChild(sp); return;
    }
    word.split("").forEach(function(c, i) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym" + (i === symIdx ? " current" : "");
      sp.textContent = c; trackEl.appendChild(sp);
    });
  }

  function renderTrace() {
    traceEl.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(r, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (i === rows.length - 1) tr.style.fontWeight = "bold";
      [r.prefix, r.nfa, r.dfa, r.accepted ? "\u2705 Yes" : "\u274c No"].forEach(function(v) {
        var td = document.createElement("td"); td.textContent = v; tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      traceEl.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function applyNfaGraph(active, usedEdges) {
    w2NfaQs.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (active.indexOf("qs") >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    w2NfaQa.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (active.indexOf("qa") >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    var loopA = usedEdges.indexOf("loop") >= 0;
    var arcA  = usedEdges.indexOf("arc") >= 0;
    w2NfaLoop.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-edge" + (loopA ? " active" : "");
    w2NfaArc.className.baseVal  = "sc-nfa-edge" + (arcA  ? " active" : "");
    w2NfaLoop.setAttribute("marker-end", loopA ? "url(#w2-arrow-red)" : "url(#w2-arrow)");
    w2NfaArc.setAttribute ("marker-end", arcA  ? "url(#w2-arrow-red)" : "url(#w2-arrow)");
  }

  function applyDfaGraph(state, usedEdge) {
    dfaS0.className.baseVal = "sc-dfa-node" + (state === "s0" ? " active" : "");
    dfaS1.className.baseVal = "sc-dfa-node" + (state === "s1" ? " active" : "");
    [edgeS0b, edgeS0a, edgeS1a, edgeS1b].forEach(function(e) {
      e.className.baseVal = "sc-dfa-edge";
      e.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#w2-dfa-arrow)");
    });
    if (usedEdge) {
      usedEdge.className.baseVal = "sc-dfa-edge active";
      usedEdge.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#w2-dfa-arrow-red)");
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (word !== inputEl.value) inputEl.value = word;
    symIdx = 0; nfaActive = ["qs"]; dfaCur = "s0";
    rows = [{ prefix: "\u03b5", nfa: "{q\u209B}", dfa: "S\u2080", accepted: false }];
    explainEl.innerHTML = "<b>Initialised.</b> Start in NFA state {q\u209B}, corresponding to DFA state S\u2080.";
    invEl.textContent = "Invariant: DFA state S\u2080 = NFA active set {q\u209B} \u2713";
    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol 0 / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyNfaGraph(["qs"], []); applyDfaGraph("s0", null);
    stepBtn.disabled = word.length === 0;
  }

  function step() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (symIdx >= word.length) return;
    var sym = word[symIdx];
    var prevNfa = nfaActive; var prevDfa = dfaCur;
    nfaActive = nfaStep(prevNfa, sym);
    dfaCur = dfaOf(nfaActive);
    symIdx++;

    var usedEdges = [];
    if (sym === "a" && prevNfa.indexOf("qs") >= 0) { usedEdges.push("loop"); usedEdges.push("arc"); }
    else if (sym === "b" && prevNfa.indexOf("qs") >= 0) { usedEdges.push("loop"); }

    var dfaEdge = null;
    if (prevDfa === "s0" && sym === "b") dfaEdge = edgeS0b;
    if (prevDfa === "s0" && sym === "a") dfaEdge = edgeS0a;
    if (prevDfa === "s1" && sym === "a") dfaEdge = edgeS1a;
    if (prevDfa === "s1" && sym === "b") dfaEdge = edgeS1b;

    var accepted = nfaActive.indexOf("qa") >= 0;
    var prefix   = word.slice(0, symIdx);
    var dfaLabel = dfaCur === "s1" ? "S\u2081 \u2605" : "S\u2080";
    var prevDfaL = prevDfa === "s1" ? "S\u2081" : "S\u2080";
    rows.push({ prefix: prefix, nfa: fmtNfa(nfaActive), dfa: dfaLabel, accepted: accepted });

    explainEl.innerHTML =
      "<b>Read \u2018" + sym + "\u2019.</b> From NFA states " + fmtNfa(prevNfa) +
      ", applying \u0394(\u00b7, " + sym + ") gives " + fmtNfa(nfaActive) + ". " +
      "DFA: " + prevDfaL + " \u2192<sup>" + sym + "</sup>\u2192 " + dfaLabel + ". " +
      (accepted ? "<b>Prefix accepted \u2705</b>" : "Prefix not accepted \u274c");

    invEl.textContent = "Invariant: DFA state " + dfaLabel + " = NFA active set " + fmtNfa(nfaActive) + " \u2713";
    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol " + symIdx + " / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyNfaGraph(nfaActive, usedEdges);
    applyDfaGraph(dfaCur, dfaEdge);
    stepBtn.disabled = symIdx >= word.length;

    if (symIdx >= word.length) {
      explainEl.innerHTML +=
        "<br><b>Word fully consumed.</b> Final DFA state: " + dfaLabel + ". " +
        (accepted ? "Ends in <code>a</code> \u2192 <b>ACCEPTED \u2705</b>" : "Does not end in <code>a</code> \u2192 <b>REJECTED \u274c</b>");
    }
  }

  inputEl.addEventListener("input", reset);
  stepBtn.addEventListener("click", step);
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", reset);
  reset();
})();
</script>
```

---

## What To Notice

1. **Only 2 reachable DFA states out of 4 possible.**
   A 2-state NFA could produce up to $2^2 = 4$ subset states
   ($\varnothing$, $\{q_s\}$, $\{q_a\}$, $\{q_s,q_a\}$), but the worklist
   algorithm discovered only $\{q_s\}$ and $\{q_s,q_a\}$.

2. **$\{q_a\}$ is unreachable.**
   $q_a$ is only reached from $q_s$ via the $a$-arc.
   Since $q_a$ has no outgoing transitions, it can never appear *alone* in an
   active set — it always arrives together with $q_s$ (which keeps itself alive
   via the self-loop).  Hence $\{q_a\}$ is never generated by the worklist.

3. **The invariant in action.**
   At every moment in Widget 2 the DFA-state label *is* the NFA active set.
   The subset construction packages the power-set computation into a single
   deterministic state name.

4. **Acceptance corresponds to $S \cap F \neq \varnothing$.**
   A DFA state $S$ is accepting precisely when it contains at least one NFA
   accepting state ($q_a \in S$).  That is why only $\{q_s,q_a\}$ is a DFA
   accepting state, reflecting that the word prefix read so far ends in $a$.
